∀ {T N : Type} {r : ContextFreeRule T N} {u v : List (Symbol T N)},
  r.Rewrites u v →
    ∀ (p : List (Symbol T N)) {w : List (Symbol T N)},
      Symbol.nonterminal r.input ∉ w →
        w.Subperm (p ++ u ++ p) →
          ∀ (a : Symbol T N → Bool) {b : ℕ}, Set.Ioc (List.countP a (p ++ u ++ p)) b ≠ ⊤

referees.justification: The 8-step synthesis across ContextFreeRule, List, Set resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 3.62, meriting archival as a theorem. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across ContextFreeRule, List, Set, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 8 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a lemma of modest significance (5/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
